question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Everlasting
solution: The correct answer is option 2), i.e., 'Transient.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option: • Everlasting- lasting forever; eternal. (शाश्वत; सदा के लिए; चिरस्थायी) • Transient- lasting only for a short time; impermanent. (क्षणिक, अस्थायी) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • Eternal- lasting or existing forever; without end. (शाश्वत) • Fatuous- silly and pointless. (बुद्धिहीन) • Misled- deceived; led astray. (गुमराह) • Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Everlasting' and 'Transient' are antonyms. • So, the correct answer is option 2. 1d4:Ta76e,
